description: Simple revenue distribution contract. Receives USDC when the vault forwards deducted funds and lets the admin distribute those funds to developer wallets individually or in batch.

functions.name: init
functions.description: Initialize the revenue pool with an admin and the USDC token address. Can only be called once. The admin must authorize the call.

params.name: admin
params.description: Address that may call distribute, batch_distribute, receive_payment, and set_admin.

params.name: usdc_token
params.description: Stellar USDC (or wrapped USDC) token contract address.

panics: "revenue pool already initialized" — called more than once.

functions.name: pause
functions.description: Activate the circuit-breaker. Blocks distribute and batch_distribute until unpause is called. Admin rotation (set_admin / claim_admin) remains available while paused.

params.name: caller
params.description: Must be the current admin or configured pause guardian; must authorize.

panics: "unauthorized: caller is not admin or pause guardian" — caller is neither current admin nor configured pause guardian.
"revenue pool already paused" — pool is already paused.

functions.name: unpause
functions.description: Deactivate the circuit-breaker, restoring distribute and batch_distribute.

params.name: caller
params.description: Must be the current admin; must authorize.

panics: "unauthorized: caller is not admin" — caller != current admin.
"revenue pool not paused" — pool is not currently paused.

functions.name: is_paused
functions.description: Return true if the revenue pool is currently paused, false otherwise. Defaults to false before any pause call.

functions.name: set_pause_guardian
functions.description: Set or replace the emergency pause guardian. The guardian can pause the pool but cannot unpause, distribute, rotate admin, change caps, or upgrade.

params.name: caller
params.description: Must be the current admin; must authorize.

params.name: guardian
params.description: Address that may call pause.

panics: "unauthorized: caller is not admin" — caller != current admin.

functions.name: clear_pause_guardian
functions.description: Remove the configured emergency pause guardian. After clearing, only the admin can pause.

params.name: caller
params.description: Must be the current admin; must authorize.

panics: "unauthorized: caller is not admin" — caller != current admin.
"no pause guardian set" — no guardian is configured.

functions.name: get_pause_guardian
functions.description: Return the configured emergency pause guardian, or None if no guardian is set.

functions.name: distribute
functions.description: Transfer USDC from this contract to a developer wallet. Admin only. Blocked while paused.

params.name: caller
params.description: Must be the current admin; must authorize.

params.name: to
params.description: Developer address to receive USDC.

params.name: amount
params.description: Amount in USDC base units; must be > 0.

panics: "revenue pool is paused" — pool is paused.
"unauthorized: caller is not admin" — caller != current admin.
"amount must be positive" — amount <= 0.
"revenue pool not initialized" — called before init.
"insufficient USDC balance" — contract holds less than amount.

functions.name: batch_distribute
functions.description: Atomically distribute USDC to multiple developer wallets. Validates the total against the available balance before any transfer. One event is emitted per payment. Admin only. Blocked while paused.

params.name: caller
params.description: Must be the current admin; must authorize.

params.name: payments
params.description: Ordered list of (developer_address, amount) pairs. All amounts must be > 0.

panics: "revenue pool is paused" — pool is paused.
"unauthorized: caller is not admin" — caller != current admin.
"amount must be positive" — any individual amount <= 0.
"total overflow" — extremely unlikely sum overflow.
"revenue pool not initialized" — called before init.
"insufficient USDC balance" — total amount exceeds contract balance.

functions.name: receive_payment
functions.description: Event-only helper — does NOT move tokens. Emits a receive_payment event for indexer alignment when the backend wants to log a payment credited from the vault. USDC is received passively when any address transfers tokens to this contract; no explicit call is required for token receipt.

params.name: caller
params.description: Must be the current admin; must authorize.

params.name: amount
params.description: Amount received (for event logging only; no tokens are moved).

params.name: from_vault
params.description: True if the source was the vault contract.

panics: "unauthorized: caller is not admin" — caller != current admin.

functions.name: balance
functions.description: Return the contract's current USDC balance.
panics: "revenue pool not initialized" — called before init.

functions.name: get_ttl_policy
functions.description: Return the TTL policy (threshold and bump_amount) this contract applies to each storage category. Reports policy constants only: a contract cannot observe the remaining TTL of a ledger entry, so TtlPolicy deliberately has no live ttl field. Read live TTLs over Soroban RPC getLedgerEntries and compare liveUntilLedgerSeq against latestLedger; see docs/STORAGE_TTL_DOCTOR.md. Renamed from get_storage_ttl, whose ttl field was the live instance TTL under cfg(test) but the constant BUMP_AMOUNT in production builds.

functions.name: get_admin
functions.description: Return the current admin address.
panics: "revenue pool not initialized" — called before init.

functions.name: get_pending_admin
functions.description: Return the pending admin address, or null if no two-step transfer is in progress. Integrators can poll this to detect an in-flight admin handover before accept_admin or claim_admin is called.

functions.name: set_admin
functions.description: Initiate replacement of the current admin. The proposed new admin must call claim_admin to complete the transfer.

params.name: caller
params.description: Must be the current admin; must authorize.

params.name: new_admin
params.description: Address of the proposed new admin.

panics: "unauthorized: caller is not admin" — caller != current admin.

functions.name: get_treasury
functions.description: Return the current treasury address authorized to call deposit_yield. Deployments without a dedicated treasury key fall back to the admin address.
panics: "revenue pool not initialized" — called before init and no treasury fallback exists.

functions.name: get_pending_treasury
functions.description: Return the pending treasury address, or null if no two-step treasury transfer is in progress.

functions.name: set_treasury
functions.description: Nominate a new treasury. The current admin must authorize, and the nominee must call accept_treasury before deposit_yield authority changes.

params.name: caller
params.description: Must be the current admin; must authorize.

params.name: new_treasury
params.description: Address of the proposed treasury.

panics: "unauthorized: caller is not admin" — caller != current admin.
"new treasury is already current treasury" — nominee is already active.

functions.name: accept_treasury
functions.description: Complete a pending treasury transfer. Must be called by the pending treasury.

params.name: caller
params.description: Must be the pending treasury; must authorize.

panics: "no pending treasury" — set_treasury was not called first.
"unauthorized: caller is not pending treasury" — caller is not the pending treasury.

functions.name: cancel_treasury_transfer
functions.description: Cancel a pending treasury transfer. Only the current admin may call this.

params.name: caller
params.description: Must be the current admin; must authorize.

panics: "unauthorized: caller is not admin" — caller != current admin.
"no treasury transfer pending" — no pending treasury is configured.

functions.name: claim_admin
functions.description: Complete the admin transfer. Must be called by the pending admin set via set_admin.

params.name: caller
params.description: Must be the pending admin; must authorize.

panics: "no pending admin" — set_admin was not called first.
"unauthorized: caller is not pending admin" — caller is not the pending admin.

functions.name: propose_emergency_drain
functions.description: Propose a timelocked USDC emergency drain to a treasury address. Stores a PendingEmergencyDrain snapshot; execution is only possible after EMERGENCY_DRAIN_TIMELOCK_SECONDS (86 400 s = 24 h) have elapsed. A new proposal replaces any existing one, resetting the clock. When the admin is a Stellar multisig account, require_auth enforces the native multi-signature threshold automatically, providing Multisig + timelock protection.
functions.access: admin (must sign; multisig threshold enforced by Soroban host when admin is a multisig account)

params.name: caller
params.description: Must be the current admin; must authorize.

params.name: treasury
params.description: Destination address for drained USDC. Cannot be the contract itself.

params.name: amount
params.description: USDC amount in base units. Must be positive.

panics: "unauthorized: caller is not admin" — caller != current admin.
"amount must be positive" — amount <= 0.
"invalid recipient: cannot drain to the contract itself" — treasury == contract address.
"timelock overflow" — proposed_at + 86400 would overflow u64.

functions.name: execute_emergency_drain
functions.description: Execute a pending emergency drain after the 24-hour timelock has expired. Transfers the proposed USDC amount to the destination address and removes the pending snapshot (replay protection).

params.name: caller
params.description: Must be the current admin; must authorize.

panics: "unauthorized: caller is not admin" — caller != current admin.
"no pending emergency drain" — propose_emergency_drain was not called first.
"emergency drain timelock has not expired" — current timestamp < execute_after.
"insufficient USDC balance" — contract holds less than the proposed amount.

functions.name: cancel_emergency_drain
functions.description: Cancel a pending emergency drain. May be called at any time before execution, including before the timelock expires. Removes the snapshot and emits an audit event.

params.name: caller
params.description: Must be the current admin; must authorize.

panics: "unauthorized: caller is not admin" — caller != current admin.
"no pending emergency drain" — no proposal exists to cancel.

functions.name: get_pending_emergency_drain
functions.description: Return the pending emergency drain proposal snapshot, or null if none exists. Off-chain monitors and the admin can poll this to verify or cancel a pending drain before the timelock expires.

PendingEmergencyDrain.description: Immutable snapshot of a pending emergency drain proposal.

to.description: Destination address for the drained USDC.

amount.description: USDC amount in base units to drain.

proposed_at.description: Ledger timestamp (seconds) when the proposal was created.

execute_after.description: Earliest ledger timestamp at which execute_emergency_drain may succeed. Equals proposed_at + 86400.

TtlPolicy.description: TTL policy the revenue pool applies to one storage category. Deliberately carries no live ttl field: contract code cannot read an entry's remaining TTL, so live TTLs come from Soroban RPC getLedgerEntries (docs/STORAGE_TTL_DOCTOR.md).

key_desc.description: Human-readable description of the keys this policy covers.

threshold.description: Remaining TTL (in ledgers) below which the contract extends the entry.

bump_amount.description: TTL (in ledgers) the entry is extended to once the threshold is crossed.
